Rabhasanandin
Buddhist a.
--Sambandhoddyota (on Ṣaṭkāraka). B. IV. 102. |23|75

Rabhasapāla
(between 500-900 A. D.). lexicographer. His work is known only through quotations in the works of Sarvānanda, Kṛṣṇasvāmī, Mādhavīya Dhātuvṛtti, Medinīkāra, Rāyamukuṭa, Bhaṭṭojī, Bhānujī, Śivarāma on Vāsavadattā, Bharatasena on Bhaṭṭikāvya, in Dhātunirṇaya, IO. 893; Trikāṇḍaviveka, IO. 963; Sarvacandra on Vāsavadattā, IO. 4407.
See Patkar's Thesis, p. 58 ff. |23|75
